{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify that the conversion worked
print("Sample of converted 'revenue':")
print(sales_df['revenue'].head())

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders count:", sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0])

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment']))"}
